mapper.insert: insert into repair_order ( order_no, reporter_name, contact, lab_id, device_id, fault_type, priority_level, status, assignee_name, deadline, progress, description, result_desc ) values ( #{ticket}, #{reporter}, #{contact}, coalesce( (select id from lab where lab_name = #{lab} or concat(lab_code, ' ', lab_name) = #{lab} or lab_code = substring_index(#{lab}, ' ', 1) limit 1), 1 ), (select id from device where device_name = #{device} or device_code = #{device} limit 1), #{faultType}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{assignee}, #{deadline}, #{progress}, #{description}, #{result} )

mapper.update: update repair_order set reporter_name = #{repair.reporter}, contact = #{repair.contact}, lab_id = coalesce( (select id from lab where lab_name = #{repair.lab} or concat(lab_code, ' ', lab_name) = #{repair.lab} or lab_code = substring_index(#{repair.lab}, ' ', 1) limit 1), lab_id ), device_id = coalesce( (select id from device where device_name = #{repair.device} or device_code = #{repair.device} limit 1), device_id ), fault_type = #{repair.faultType}, priority_level = #{repair.priority}, status = #{repair.status}, assignee_name = #{repair.assignee}, deadline = #{repair.deadline}, progress = #{repair.progress}, description = #{repair.description}, result_desc = #{repair.result}, updated_at = now() where order_no = #{id} or cast(id as char) = #{id}
